title: Câu gián tiếp: She said that…
summary: Kể lại lời người khác nói: say và tell, lùi thì, đổi đại từ và từ chỉ thời gian, nơi chốn.

dialogue.en: Did you talk to Hoa yesterday?
dialogue.vi: Hôm qua bạn có nói chuyện với Hoa không?

dialogue.en: Yes. She [[said]] she [[was]] moving to Da Nang.
dialogue.vi: Có. Cô ấy bảo cô ấy sắp chuyển vào Đà Nẵng.

dialogue.en: She [[told]] me she [[had found]] a new job there.
dialogue.vi: Cô ấy kể với mình là đã tìm được việc mới ở đó.

dialogue.en: She [[said]] she [[would]] leave the next week.
dialogue.vi: Cô ấy nói tuần sau sẽ đi.

sections.heading: Say và tell
sections.rule: **say (that) + câu**; **tell + người + (that) + câu**. Tell **luôn có người nghe** ngay sau.
body: Không nói *She said me*, cũng không nói *She told that…*. Nếu muốn nhắc người nghe sau say thì dùng *said to me*, nhưng *told me* tự nhiên hơn.

examples.vi: Anh ấy nói anh ấy mệt.
examples.why: Say + câu, không có người nghe.

examples.vi: Anh ấy bảo tôi là anh ấy mệt.

examples.en: She [[told]] us that the shop was closed.
examples.vi: Cô ấy bảo chúng tôi là cửa hàng đóng cửa.

check.prompt: My boss ___ me I could leave early.
check.explain: Có người nghe (me) ngay sau → told.

sections.heading: Lùi một thì về quá khứ
sections.rule: Khi **said / told** ở quá khứ, động từ trong lời kể thường **lùi một thì**: hiện tại → quá khứ, quá khứ → quá khứ hoàn thành, will → would.
body: Nếu điều được nói **vẫn còn đúng** bây giờ, có thể giữ nguyên thì: *He said he lives in Hue* (giờ vẫn sống ở Huế).

head: Lời nói trực tiếp
Lời kể lại
rows: He said he had seen him.
She said she would call me.

examples.vi: Cô ấy nói cô ấy đói.

examples.en: "I will help you." → He said he [[would]] help me.
examples.vi: Anh ấy nói sẽ giúp tôi.

examples.en: "I lost my keys." → She said she [[had lost]] her keys.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nói đã làm mất chìa khóa.
examples.why: Quá khứ đơn → quá khứ hoàn thành.

check.prompt: "I can drive." → He said he ___ drive.

sections.heading: Đổi đại từ, thời gian, nơi chốn
sections.rule: Đổi **đại từ** theo người kể; đổi **today, tomorrow, here** cho hợp lúc kể: that day, the next day, there.

examples.en: "I'll see you tomorrow." → She said she would see me [[the next day]].
examples.vi: Cô ấy nói hôm sau sẽ gặp tôi.
examples.why: Tomorrow → the next day; you → me.

examples.en: "I'm staying here." → He said he was staying [[there]].
examples.vi: Anh ấy nói đang ở đó.

check.prompt: "I'm leaving today." → She said she was leaving ___.
check.explain: Kể lại sau đó → today thành that day.

mistakes.wrong: She said me she was tired.
mistakes.right: She told me she was tired.

mistakes.wrong: He told that he was busy.
mistakes.right: He said that he was busy.
mistakes.why: Tell phải có người nghe; không có thì dùng said.

mistakes.wrong: She said she is going to the market tomorrow.
mistakes.right: She said she was going to the market the next day.
mistakes.why: Lùi thì và đổi tomorrow → the next day.

exercises.prompt: Lan ___ me that she liked my dress.
"I am cold." → He said he ___ cold.
"We will finish soon." → They said they ___ finish soon.
"I have done my homework." → He said he ___ his homework.
answers: had done

exercises.prompt: "I live in Hanoi." → She said she ___ in Hanoi.
answers: lived
lives
exercises.explain: Lùi thì: lived (giữ lives nếu vẫn còn đúng).

answers: said

exercises.prompt: "I bought it yesterday." → She said she had bought it the ___ before.
answers: day

exercises.prompt: "I can't come." → Minh said he ___ come.
answers: couldn't
could not

exercises.vi: Cô ấy bảo tôi là cô ấy rất bận.
Anh ấy nói anh ấy sẽ gọi lại.

exercises.sentence: My mother said me to be careful, and she was right.
answers: My mother told me to be careful, and she was right.

exercises.sentence: He said he will be late.
answers: He said he would be late.

exercises.sentence: She told that she was hungry.
answers: She said that she was hungry.

exercises.vi: Anh ấy nói anh ấy đang học tiếng Nhật.
answers: He said he was learning Japanese.
He said that he was learning Japanese.
He said he was studying Japanese.
He said that he was studying Japanese.
He said he is learning Japanese.
He said he is studying Japanese.

exercises.vi: Cô ấy bảo tôi là cô ấy đã xem phim đó rồi.
answers: She told me she had seen that film.
She told me that she had seen that film.
She told me she had already seen that film.
She told me that she had already seen that film.
She told me she had seen that movie.
She told me that she had seen that movie.
She told me she had already seen that movie.
